mintAuthority.summary: stkGHO.v1 is an ERC-4626-style Umbrella staking receipt over GHO; wrapper minting is deposit/share accounting while durable GHO mint authority is inherited from reviewed Aave facilitator controls. The proxy is upgradeable via Aave Governance V3 Level-1 Executor, a bounded on-chain governance path.

upgradeability.controlRef: Aave Governance V3 Level-1 Executor (proxy upgrade admin owner)

controls.label: stkGHO Umbrella wrapper (upgradeable proxy)
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25295167: asset() returned GHO 0x40D16FC0246aD3160Ccc09B8D0D3A2cD28aE6C2f confirmed. EIP-1967 impl slot = 0x75e8ac0c063b6966e2a9954adedf39bde9370197; admin slot = 0xde9f8379a5a972100d0373103a849e8abdf56a9a (ProxyAdmin). ProxyAdmin.owner() = 0x5300A1a15135EA4dc7aD5a167152C01EFc9b192A (Aave Governance V3 Level-1 Executor). Upgrade path is bounded by on-chain Aave governance.

controls.label: Aave Governance V3 Level-1 Executor (proxy upgrade admin owner)
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 26101008, ProxyAdmin.owner() remains Aave Governance V3 Level-1 Executor 0x5300a1a15135ea4dc7ad5a167152c01efc9b192a. Executor.owner() is PayloadsController 0xdabad81af85554e9ae636395611c58f7ec1aaec5; getExecutorSettingsByAccessControl(1) returns this executor and an 86400-second delay, enforced by executePayload. The executor retains Umbrella DEFAULT_ADMIN, PAUSE_GUARDIAN, COVERAGE_MANAGER and RESCUE_GUARDIAN roles. This governance delay does not bind the separately authorized 3-of-5 DEFAULT_ADMIN Safe or 4-of-7 pause Safe.

controls.label: Umbrella stkGHO owner and deficit-slashing controller
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 26101008, stkGHO.owner() is Umbrella 0xd400fc38ed4732893174325693a63c30ee3881a8 and its GHO slashing config targets stkGHO with oracle 0xd110cac5d8682a3b045d5524a9903e031d70fccd and liquidationFee 0. StakeToken restricts slash, pause and cooldown/unstake-window changes to its owner. Umbrella.slash is permissionless, conditioned on a configured reserve deficit; the deployed ABI/source has no SLASH_MANAGER role. DEFAULT_ADMIN controls slashing configurations, pricing oracle, fee (at most 100%), deficit offset, cooldown/unstake window and role grants. Complete RoleGranted/RoleRevoked history from block 0 through the pin plus hasRole reads identifies Aave's executor and the 3-of-5 Safe below as admins, and the executor plus the 4-of-7 Safe below as pause guardians. Powers affect the local stkGHO receipt's principal or access, not durable GHO mint authority. RewardsController admin is the executor, with rewards-only configuration also delegated to 0x2759de67ad133c747c9f41d56f1b8a343ce679a1; these incentive powers do not provide a principal-slashing or GHO-mint entrypoint.

controls.label: Umbrella DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE Safe (3-of-5)
controls.capDescription: No GHO mint or proxy-upgrade authority. DEFAULT_ADMIN can change local receipt slashing configuration, oracle, liquidation fee (0-100%), deficit offset and exit timing, and grant/revoke all Umbrella roles; loss exposure is stkGHO deposited principal, not parent GHO issuance.

sources.label: Verified Umbrella role-gated configuration and emergency methods

controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 26101008, full Umbrella RoleGranted/RoleRevoked history includes the executor's DEFAULT_ADMIN grant at 22481753 and this Safe's grant at 25037701, with no revocations or other admin grants. hasRole(DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE,Safe) is true. Pinned Safe reads show five owners, threshold 3, masterCopy and VERSION 1.4.1; module pagination ends empty at sentinel 0x1 and guard/module-guard slots are zero. Safe.execTransaction and Umbrella's admin entrypoints contain no timelock. A pinned eth_call from this Safe to setCooldownStk([(stkGHO,1728000)]) succeeds immediately; the same call from an unprivileged address reverts AccessControlUnauthorizedAccount. Admin can grant itself pause/rescue roles, but cannot upgrade the proxy or directly mint GHO.

controls.label: Umbrella PAUSE_GUARDIAN_ROLE Safe (4-of-7)
controls.capDescription: Access-only pause/unpause of Umbrella stake tokens. This role does not grant principal slashing, slashing configuration, cooldown/unstake-window configuration, role administration, proxy upgrade or GHO mint authority.
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 26101008, full RoleGranted/RoleRevoked history identifies the executor's PAUSE_GUARDIAN grant at 22481753 and this Safe's grant at 25840198, with no revocations. hasRole confirms the active grant. Safe reads show seven owners, threshold 4, VERSION 1.3.0 and masterCopy 0xd9db270c1b5e3bd161e8c8503c55ceabee709552; modules are empty and guard/module-guard slots zero. pauseStk/unpauseStk have only the role gate, not a delay; a pinned eth_call from this Safe to pauseStk(stkGHO) succeeds. Pausing blocks deposits, withdrawals, transfers, cooldown and slashing while preserving the receipt's principal accounting.

sources.label: Verified deployed Umbrella slashing and emergency-control source

review.evidence: At Ethereum block 25295167: asset() = GHO 0x40D16FC0246aD3160Ccc09B8D0D3A2cD28aE6C2f confirmed; proxy impl = 0x75e8ac0c063b6966e2a9954adedf39bde9370197; ProxyAdmin 0xDE9F8379a5a972100d0373103a849E8ABdf56a9a owned by Aave Governance V3 Level-1 Executor 0x5300A1a15135EA4dc7aD5a167152C01EFc9b192A. Upgrade admin surface confirmed and bounded by on-chain governance. Durable mint authority inherits from reviewed parent GHO. stkGHO shares are minted only against deposited GHO, and changing the wrapper's mint economics requires the Aave Governance executor; the encoding-derived unbounded value is therefore superseded by raiseable economic semantics. 2026-07-21 gap-fill pass: the mintAuthority.upgradeability object was added, structuring this same already-verified EIP-1967 proxy/ProxyAdmin/executor evidence into the record's canChangeMintLogic/controlRef fields; no new on-chain read was required. Economic-posture fields reviewed 2026-08-15: deposit-gated shares can be altered only through Aave governance, while local reconciliation is not applicable and no local attestor or prudential supervisor is evidenced.
